science_card_focus: Extract a different matched family from the paper temperature-profile equation, not the Lorenz-ratio family. Fix common M=20, T_S=35 mK, T_D=15 mK, HCB/no-electron-phonon/instant-feedback, and large-chain approximation. Public control is integer island position k with source-defined allowed values 1 through 20. Common dimensionless readout theta_k=(T_k^2-T_mid^2)/((T_S^2-T_D^2)/2). Private N=1 branch has theta_k=0 exactly because every island is at T_mid. Private N=2 branch uses Delta=sqrt((N-1)(M+1))/2=sqrt(21)/2 and theta_k=exp(-k/Delta)-exp(-(21-k)/Delta), directly from T_profile_simple. Encode all constants as anchored parameters with add/subtract/multiply/divide/power/negate/exp. Add branch-private N=1/N=2 conditions and cite them. Preserve approximate semantics for N=2 and do not claim raw measured points or reuse Lorenz readout.
